integrity: A self-contained analytic proof and standalone standard-library numerical checker are supplied; numerical checks do not replace the global proof. No independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Noiseless two-branch data at two wavenumbers; absolutely ordered layer-depth assignment and absolute density scale are unobservable. No capillarity, shear, noise, or inversion stability result. One prior inverse-ship-wave paper was inaccessible in full text.
title: Two-wavenumber tomography and an exact depth-reflection ambiguity for two-layer gravity waves
